name: Artist Pulse
overview: Top Songs, complete Albums/Singles, and Similar Artists for Jellyfin artist pages.
description: Artist Pulse adds local-first Top Songs, complete Albums and Singles/EPs, and local-only ListenBrainz Similar Artists to Jellyfin Web artist pages. It preserves server-wide Jellyfin ranks, then appends cached, rate-limited ListenBrainz matches that are available locally—never remote-only tracks or artists.

versions.changelog: Preserve last-known-good ListenBrainz cache data during outages, add current artist-page screenshots, and ship a runtime-only ZIP.
Complete Albums and Singles/EPs, local-only ListenBrainz Similar Artists in a native circular carousel, More Like This replacement, and refined Top Songs controls.
Local-first Top Songs completion, resilient first-page rendering, native favourite controls, Album/Single fixes, and immediate Show less.
Server-wide Jellyfin Top Songs, resilient first-page rendering, native favourite controls, and immediate Show less.
Initial public release: local-first Top Songs, ranked queue playback, native favourite state, and Albums / Singles & EPs split.
